comparison.objective: Candidate tunes and locks a shock absorber; record inserts a USB-A cable into an adapter port.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate requires recessed key engagement, setscrew operation, counterholding, fine collar rotation, and test cycling; record requires cable/port alignment and insertion.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate measures safe stopping performance and retention. Board record omits setup, scoring, electrical verification, insertion tolerance, damage criteria, and run limit.
comparison.reason: USB insertion does not test adjustable damping, lock torque, or response-guided commissioning.
